user_prompt:
What is the effect of any iron-containing supplement, compared with the same supplement
without iron or no treatment/placebo, on maternal iron-deficiency anaemia at term (defined
as haemoglobin less than 110 g/L plus at least one additional laboratory indicator of iron
deficiency, assessed at 37 weeks' gestation or later) during pregnancy? If a trial reports
zero events in both arms, treat it as not estimable and exclude it from pooling.
